Good afternoon, everybody. It is time for the awards of the year. This year was not easy, but our results are the best in five years. The award for the most efficient plant goes to France. The award for the best delivery goes to Brazil: ninety-eight percent on time, the highest number in the group. Congratulations, Rodrigo, and congratulations to the team in Brazil! And a special award, for the most improved team, goes to Shanghai. Thank you all, and let us make next year even better.

New York in numbers. The tallest building in the city is One World Trade Center, one thousand seven hundred and seventy-six feet. The biggest park is not Central Park. It is Pelham Bay Park, in the Bronx. The busiest subway station is Times Square, with more than fifty million people a year. And the oldest bridge in the city? It is not the Brooklyn Bridge. It is the High Bridge, from eighteen forty-eight.

Claire opened the forum with the ranking of the year. France was the biggest and the most efficient plant. Brazil had the fastest deliveries and got the award. Rodrigo said that transport was their worst result. At the end he presented the goal for next year: zero accidents.
